verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for an AI-enabled email SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions API keys, tokens, or permission scopes for agents. The MCP material covers Shortwave connecting out to other servers as a client, which is adjacent and earns no credit, and the probes found no public OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
